messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT triggered - Sev2 in ap-northeast-1: KV cache continous-batching -> memory surge -> GPU OOMs. Alert group: kv-cache, contbatch.

maria: acked. I'm oncall. grabbing logs now. pinging @eng-runtime and @taylor.

ajay: saw anomalies in metrics ~ 3625012200 - token throughput jumped 3x, avg batch size spiked. KV cache resident size rising steadily.

taylor: noticed a config push an hour ago that toggled kv_prefetch=true + max_batch_wait_ms=40 on the contbatch fleet. rolling back config?

maria: running a quick rollback to previous batching flags on canary nodes (tokyo-canary-1). command: `kubectl patch cm contbatch-config -n runtime --type merge -p '{"data":{"kv_prefetch":"false","max_batch_wait_ms":"10"}}'`

infra-bot: deploybot: config-cm updated on tokyo-canary-1.

maria: rolling canary restart of contbatch on those nodes: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/contbatch -n runtime --selector=zone=ap-northeast-1,canary=true`

ajay: attaching a couple of logs from the pty:
```
E PyTorchCudaMalloc: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 512.00 MiB (GPU 0; 40.00 GiB total capacity; 38.1 GiB already allocated)
W kv_cache: slab allocation failed, arena fragmentation > 0.87
I contbatch: batch_size=1024 tokens, kv_resident=19.4Gi
```

taylor: can confirm the crash loop is reduced on canary after rollback. but prod still seeing churn in a subset of pods (zone tokyo-a). looks like memory fragmentation stuck due to long-lived KV pages.

kyle: adding immediate mitigation: drain and replace the worst offenders, trigger `kv-arena-compact` on their hosts. but that requires a restart of the runtime process. we need to coordinate for customer impact.

maria: status update to SRE: initiating rolling restart on 10% of tokyo-a contbatch nodes to trigger arena compaction. doing it gradual -> 10% every 3m.

eng-runtime: FYI this looks like allocator churn from recent allocator heuristics merge (PR #1582) that increases slab splitting for small-prefetch workloads. possible fragmentation cascade when combined with aggressive prefilling.

ajay: correlation: traffic shape changed (more long-context requests) which increased kv cache lifetime per key. combo of long-lived kv + kv_prefetch created many small allocations.

maria: executing `systemctl stop redwood-contbatch && /usr/local/bin/kv-arena-compact --force` on one host (host-tyo-122). logs show compaction freed ~6.2Gi.

infra-bot: host-tyo-122 restarted contbatch successfully. health checks passing.

taylor: good. prod error rate has dropped from 4.6% to 1.3% on affected services but some tail latency spikes persist.

kyle: proposing short-term hotpatch: revert allocator heuristics (revert PR #1582) on contbatch image and roll to affected AZs. build already underway.

maria: deploying emergency canary of runtime image `runtime:v2026-1582-revert-hotfix` to tokyo-canary-2. monitoring.

ajay: also pushing a config change to temporarily lower `max_batch_tokens` from 4096 -> 1024 to reduce per-request memory pressure.

eng-runtime: heads-up: reverting allocator change will reduce fragmentation risk, but we should also add an allocator-level fallback to coalesce small slabs when fragmentation > 0.8. follow-up ticket created ENGRT-4392.

maria: customer impact assessment: about ~2% of requests timed out or returned 502s during the peak. major consumer: partner-search has intermittent degraded latency; we reached out to CS to notify top partners. will update postmortem.

ajay: running a targeted repro on a dev rig to try to reproduce fragmentation: script attached: `python tools/repro_frag.py --seed=22 --open_context=3200 --prefetch=on`. initial run shows fragmentation delta ~0.12 per 1k requests.

eng-runtime: looking at the codepath — prefetch path creates many short-lived tensors on CUDA that don't free synchronously; combined with caching this leads to memory asynchronously held by CUDA caching allocator. might be exacerbated by newer pytorch cuda alloc patterns.

maria: handoff note for next oncall (sre-rotation):
- current mitigation: allocator revert canary deployed; rolling restart ongoing to compact arenas; kv_prefetch disabled cluster-wide for contbatch; max_batch_tokens lowered.
- impact: customer-facing error rate reduced to ~0.8% after mitigations. ongoing tail latency spikes on tokyo-a.
- next steps: monitor for reappearance for 2 hours, if tail latency > 200ms 95p on contbatch route, escalate to eng-runtime and pause contbatch autoscaling.

sre-rotation: acked. will take over monitoring at 3625012460. please leave any remaining logs in #incidents.

maria: quick post-fix checklist: open support ticket with high-touch partners, add canary metrics to alerts for kv_resident and arena_frag_ratio; schedule a deeper allocator + pytorch investigation with eng-ml.

eng-runtime: adding a short-term instrumentation patch to emit `arena_compactable_bytes` and `small_slab_count` in metrics. will roll to staging tomorrow. ticket ENGRT-4393.

ajay: after the revert and compaction roll we saw sustained reduction in OOMs. leaving a note: when enabling kv_prefetch in future, ensure bounded prefetch budget per-model to avoid unbounded slab growth.

maria: closing pagerduty alert as mitigations are in place and customer impact contained. will file a full postmortem with timeline and mitigations + long-term fixes. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Alert resolved - incident closed by maria at 3625012485.
